text: Quick question: I'm heading to Tacoma next week for the client workshop. What's the max hotel rate I can expense per night? And do I need to keep meal receipts?

Hey Jonas, for Tacoma the hotel cap is $210/night. For meals, you just claim the $55/day per diem—no need to keep receipts for that. All this is in the Travel & Expenses Policy doc if you need more details.
Awesome, thanks Miguel! And just to confirm, I should book the hotel and flights through TripNest, right?
Yep, both hotel and flights should go through TripNest. Let me know if you run into any issues booking or if you need the policy doc link.
